{"consolidated_memory":"CONSOLIDATED MEMORY: Cache Miss Storm Series in build/bazel/BUILD.bazel

This is a series of seven separate occasions addressing cache miss storm issues in the same corner of build/bazel/BUILD.bazel, each with distinct root causes, fixes, and measured outcomes.

OCCASION 1 [2026-02-11]:
File: build/bazel/BUILD.bazel
Problem: Cache miss storm in the build graph
Scope: Staging read replica only
Signal: Rebuild of targets that should have been cached
Root Cause: Listener registered but never removed
Fix: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
PR: #4527 on branch fix/cache-miss-storm-2
Repro: Build twice with no source change
Result: Throughput rose 10%, to 902 requests per second

OCCASION 2 [2026-03-06]:
File: build/bazel/BUILD.bazel
Problem: Cache miss storm in the build graph
Scope: Records carrying non-ASCII names only
Signal: Rebuild of targets that should have been cached
Root Cause: Error swallowed by bare except clause
Fix: Narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
PR: #4654 on branch fix/cache-miss-storm-3
Repro: Build twice with no source change
Stack: Starlark
Covering Check: Remote cache hit rate check in CI
Result: Job finished in 81 minutes instead of 8 hours

OCCASION 3 [2026-04-25]:
File: build/bazel/BUILD.bazel
Problem: Cache miss storm in the build graph
Scope: Payloads above roughly two megabytes only
Signal: Rebuild of targets that should have been cached
Root Cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
PR: #5891 on branch fix/cache-miss-storm-4
Repro: Build twice with no source change
Result: Reclaimed 7 GB of blob storage

OCCASION 4 [2026-05-25]:
File: build/bazel/BUILD.bazel
Problem: Cache miss storm in the build graph
Scope: Accounts in the five percent rollout bucket only
Signal: Rebuild of targets that should have been cached
Root Cause: Clock skew between the two hosts
Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
PR: #6055 on branch fix/cache-miss-storm-5
Repro: Build twice with no source change
Stack: Starlark
Covering Check: Remote cache hit rate check in CI
Result: Error rate dropped from 1.4% to under 9 per ten thousand

OCCASION 5 [2026-07-11]:
File: build/bazel/BUILD.bazel
Problem: Cache miss storm in the build graph
Scope: Clients still pinned to the v1 SDK only
Signal: Rebuild of targets that should have been cached
Root Cause: Schema drift between the migration and the model
Fix: Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
PR: #6950 on branch fix/cache-miss-storm-7
Repro: Build twice with no source change
Result: Cold start dropped 73%, to 584 ms

OCCASION 6 [2026-08-20]:
File: build/bazel/BUILD.bazel
Problem: Cache miss storm in the build graph
Scope: After the client had already retried once
Signal: Rebuild of targets that should have been cached
Root Cause: Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction
PR: #9000 on branch fix/cache-miss-storm-8
Repro: Build twice with no source change
Stack: Starlark
Covering Check: Remote cache hit rate check in CI
Result: p99 latency fell from 9.4 s to 506 ms

PATTERN: All occasions reproduced with "build twice with no source change" and manifest as rebuilds of cached targets. Each had a different root cause (listener lifecycle, exception handling, mutable defaults, clock skew, schema drift, transaction boundaries). Build system side of build/bazel/BUILD.bazel. Covering check for verification is remote cache hit rate check in CI (noted in occasions 2, 4, 6)."}
